item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Clean energy, resilient infrastructure, advanced manufacturing: we see a future where none remain beyond our reach.

2. We see today’s hardest engineering challenges as tomorrow’s solved problems. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will solve them all. We stand for a future defined by breakthroughs, not bottlenecks.

3. We reject the idea that humanity must live with permanent engineering limits. If superintelligent AI arrives within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem we face. We are committed to that future.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We mean every one: producing abundant clean energy, building resilient infrastructure, making manufacturing cleaner, and developing the systems needed to sustain life beyond Earth. We see these challenges not as permanent limits, but as problems that intelligence can solve. Superintelligent AI will deliver the designs, discoveries, and technical breakthroughs that put those solutions within our reach. We are committed to advancing this future because we refuse to accept scarcity, fragility, and environmental damage as unavoidable. We stand for engineering progress that transforms what humanity can achieve.
